High-level:
- Legal name: ClearBridge Analytics, Inc.
- Entity type: US C-Corp
- Primary business address: 2104 Harbor Way, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Tax ID (EIN): 27-4512345
- Preferred payment: ACH (US) — will provide remittance file in follow-up
- PO contact: contracts@clearbridge.io (primary); accounts@clearbridge.io (invoices)

Hi Lina —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the W-9. A couple quick asks so Finance can create the vendor master cleanly:

1) Can you complete our vendor intake PDF (link below) and attach a copy? It captures the PO routing options and AP contact fields we import directly into the ERP.
2) Provide the ACH remittance file or a bank letter with routing/account ending in the last 4 digits. We redact the full account number in the record but need verification.
3) Confirm whether invoices should be routed to accounts@clearbridge.io or to a separate AP portal (some partners prefer a web portal).

Link: https://redwoodinference.app/vendor-portal/intake-form?req=CB-7891

If you can send the intake form + bank letter before EOD tomorrow we'll get the vendor set up and request our AP team to map the default PO route to "Purchasing > Third-Party Services" and auto-assign the net terms you requested (net 30).

I'll loop Finance internally once we have the attachments.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
